about: Live Neural Junkie scenario benchmarks on local Ollama models. Each run switches all in-process agents to one model tag, then executes the same implement + chat scenarios from scenarios/implement/ and scenarios/chat/.

quick.description: Smoke benchmark — 3 implement + 2 chat scenarios (~15–45 min per model on 14B class).

runs.description: Release gate — benchmark winners only (~10–20 min).

scenario_catalog.name: go-handler
scenario_catalog.description: IDE Agent implementation session on minimal Go fixture.

scenario_catalog.name: theme-toggle
scenario_catalog.description: Frontend implementation session asks for theme-related deliverable.

scenario_catalog.name: ask-mode-no-write
scenario_catalog.description: IDE Ask mode must not run implementation session or propose edits.

scenario_catalog.name: dm-backend-workspace
scenario_catalog.description: BackendEngineer DM: theme ask then workspace visibility — no fake Go packages or echo.

scenario_catalog.name: dm-backend-echo-followup
scenario_catalog.description: BackendEngineer DM: after a reply, confused follow-ups must not quote the first user message.
